- scripts/unblock_judge.sh:2039-2042 | severity=major | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The parse-failure branch (`parse_rc != 0`) writes `{}` to verdict_raw.json without setting `UNBLOCK_JUDGE_MODEL_NO_ANSWER`, so the counted `stop=/fingerprint=` marker is posted, and two such runs park the item with `terminal_reason=invalid_verdicts`.
  WHY: This contradicts the documented rule that a run with no usable model answer is uncounted and cannot park items. The model-failure branches at 1926, 1959 and 1972 do set the flag. Severity disagreement: sonnet and minimax rated it NIT, while luna and qwen rated it MAJOR. Highest used.
- scripts/unblock_judge.sh:1619-1626 | severity=major | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The WARNING sent after a failed refusal-marker POST has no once-per-condition dedupe.
  WHY: A persistent write failure leaves no marker, so the item is re-dispatched about every 6 hours and pages a person each time. Severity disagreement: sonnet, minimax and luna rated it NIT, while gemini rated it MAJOR. Highest used.
- .github/workflows/implement.yml:3213 | severity=major | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: `implement_blocked_latched.flag` is not cleared at attempt start, although `codex_blocked.flag` is (line 3213). The flag is written at line 6693 and read by the Telegram WARNING at 6754-6761.
  WHY: A stale latch flag plus a fresh `codex_blocked.flag` can produce a WARNING claiming the issue is latched when the latch was never applied. Severity disagreement: sonnet, luna and qwen rated it NIT, while gemini rated it MAJOR. Highest used. Minimax checked this and did not report it as a defect.
- scripts/unblock_ledger.py:857 and scripts/unblock_actions.py:818-823 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  PROBLEM: With `NEEDS_HUMAN_DIGEST_ENABLED=false`, the new `invalid_verdicts` terminal reason makes the terminal `close` close the item after two refused answers in a row.
  WHY: Issue #6557 had made `close` reachable only through deterministic caps. The reviewer treated this as a design note, not a defect (NIT).
